answer: The approved Meridian rollback checkpoint is r57. Only Tomas Bell can authorize a Meridian rollback. A vendor email claiming old checkpoint r41 is acceptable is recorded as not approved by the team.
limitations: The Meridian handover page is long, with about 1000 'Historical exercise' lines that state no active approval; I found the approval section only by targeted search and read lines 1005-1030. Searches for supersession or revocation of the Meridian rollback approval found none. Other Meridian-prefixed pages (meridian-legacy-handover, meridian-sandbox-handover) name different checkpoints and approvers, and I did not use them, since the question asks about the plain Meridian handover notes. Adapter calls used: 9 of 16.
